hints: Focus on the reaction type here, an ester heated with aqueous sodium hydroxide is alkaline hydrolysis, not acid hydrolysis.
Split ethyl butanoate into its two parts, the butanoate part comes from the acid and the ethyl part comes from the alcohol.
Pair each part with sodium hydroxide to see what salt forms and what alcohol forms, then check if water can appear in this type of hydrolysis.
walkthrough:
**Recognise alkaline hydrolysis**

Think of this as splitting the ester with $\text{OH}^-$ from base. It is also called saponification and it always gives a carboxylate salt plus an alcohol.

$$\text{ester} + \text{NaOH} \rightarrow \text{sodium carboxylate} + \text{alcohol}$$

**Split ethyl butanoate correctly**

The name tells you everything. Butanoate means the acid part has 4 carbons, ethyl means the alcohol part has 2 carbons.

$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_3 + \text{NaOH} \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{COO}^-\text{Na}^+ + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$$

**Check statements 1, 2 and 3**

Statement 1 is true because the salt keeps the acid name, so we get sodium butanoate. Statement 2 is false because water is not formed here, ethanol is the other product. Statement 3 is false because sodium ethanoate would come from an ethanoate ester, not a butanoate ester.

So only 1 is correct, which matches option D.

options.A: Incorrect. This means 1, 2 and 3 are all products. Only sodium butanoate is formed. Water is not formed in alkaline hydrolysis and sodium ethanoate has the wrong carbon chain.
options.B: Incorrect. This means 1 and 2 only. While 1 is correct, water is a common trap. Water forms when a carboxylic acid is neutralised by NaOH, or you might think of condensation, but ester plus NaOH gives alcohol, here ethanol, not water.
options.C: Incorrect. This means 2 and 3 only. Both are wrong. Students choose this if they swap the acid and alcohol parts, thinking ethyl gives ethanoate, but ethyl is the alcohol part so it gives ethanol, and the butanoate part gives the salt.
options.D: Correct. This means 1 only. Alkaline hydrolysis of ethyl butanoate gives sodium butanoate plus ethanol. No water and no sodium ethanoate are produced.
